name: Article 1. In General
scope: article N.C. Gen. Stat. ch. 105A art. 1 (North Carolina General Assembly, whole-chapter pages)

notice.label: Notice before it is used on a person
notice.quote: The Department must mail the debtor written notice that the setoff has occurred and must credit the net proceeds collected to the claimant agency.

hearing.label: A chance to answer before the decision is final
hearing.quote_through: - A decision made after a hearing under this section must determine whether a debt is owed to the local agency and the amount of the debt.

appeal.label: A way to a court or an independent reviewer
appeal.quote_through: Notice of appeal shall be in writing and shall be filed with the clerk of superior court in the county where the order was entered.

access.label: The person can see the record

standing.label: The person can enforce it themselves

self-report.label: The law must report its own effects

waiver.label: Who can waive it; does it expire

fair-exchange.label: What a person gives, and what a person gets
fair-exchange.quote_gives: That portion of the amount returned that reflects the collection assistance fees must be paid from the local agency's funds.
fair-exchange.quote_gets: A local agency that returns a refund to a taxpayer under this subsection must pay from the local agency's funds any interest that has accrued since the fifth day after the Department mailed the notice of setoff to the taxpayer.
